hooks.command: input=$(cat); completed=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.todos[]? | select(.status == "completed") | .content' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | xargs); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // ""'); if [ -z "$cwd" ] || [ "$cwd" = "null" ]; then dir_context="unknown"; else dir_context=$(echo "$cwd" | sed "s|$HOME|~|" | awk -F'/' '{if (NF>=2) print $(NF-1)"/"$NF; else print $NF}'); fi; if [ "$completed" -gt 0 ]; then terminal-notifier -title "Claude Code - $dir_context" -message "Completed $completed task(s)" -sound Glass -contentImage "$HOME/.claude/icons/claude.png"; fi

input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // ""'); if [ -z "$cwd" ] || [ "$cwd" = "null" ]; then cwd=$(pwd); fi; dir_context=$(echo "$cwd" | sed "s|$HOME|~|" | awk -F'/' '{if (NF>=2) print $(NF-1)"/"$NF; else print $NF}'); terminal-notifier -title "Claude Code - $dir_context" -message "Needs permission" -sound Purr -contentImage "$HOME/.claude/icons/claude.png"

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); dir_name=$(basename "$cwd"); if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); dirty=""; git -C "$cwd" diff --quiet 2>/dev/null || dirty="*"; git -C "$cwd" diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null || dirty="${dirty}+"; remote=""; if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --verify "@{upstream}" > /dev/null 2>&1; then ahead=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-list "@{upstream}..HEAD" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | xargs); behind=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-list "HEAD..@{upstream}" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | xargs); [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ] && remote="${remote}↑"; [ "$behind" -gt 0 ] && remote="${remote}↓"; fi; git_status=" $(printf '\033[33m')${branch}${dirty}${remote}$(printf '\033[0m')"; else git_status=""; fi; printf "$(printf '\033[95m')%s$(printf '\033[0m')%s" "$dir_name" "$git_status"
